candidates.place_reason: 306d audit 2026-10-13: the 8 anchors are a trustworthy uniform 1.0 m/px square (resid 0, rot 0), but the drawn 'Roundabout' ring - labelled '90 x 60 paces' and 'in area about an acre', the real hillfort (~90 m, hatched 'Desborough Castle (Rondabout)' at the site point on the OS 6-inch) - is drawn ~500x670 m, ~5-6x too big, with its centre ~450 m SE of the real hill (the site point lands on the drawn ring's NW rim, over housing); the plate's own text matches the drawing only at ~0.18 m/px, not the fitted 1.0 m/px, and the drawn scarp oval stretches far beyond the hill (the drawn arcs over Castlefield Wood and the fields in the OS composite). Document deleted.
candidates.why: line check: fabricated anchor pattern: 2D lattice (regular ladders on both page axes); grid-round page coordinates (11 of 11 distinct values on a 10-px grid); the gate's 0.0 m measures internal consistency of the anchors, not their truth
